# Egress inventory

<!-- Generated by `pnpm egress:inventory` from apps/web/lib/egress-inventory.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every network destination the product reaches, grouped by the service that
connects. This file lists the widest case: every connector, web search, URL
fetch, the Studio browser, email and analytics on, with github.com hosts and
PostHog's US cloud. `<region>` is the deployment's AWS region and `<this app>`
is its own address. "Enabled when" names the setting that keeps the row: a
deployment that turns it off no longer makes that connection.

For one deployment's exact lists, run the command with that deployment's
environment:

- `pnpm egress:inventory --json` prints its rows.
- `pnpm egress:inventory --allowlist` prints the hosts its forward proxy must
  allow and its `NO_PROXY` list.

"Via proxy" is yes when the request leaves through `HTTPS_PROXY` in a
firewalled deployment. No means a direct connection: an AWS VPC endpoint, the
internal address, or a connection the user's browser makes from their own
network. `*` means any public host.

Not listed: the PostgreSQL database (a private address, not HTTP), and what
the container platform needs before the app starts (image pull from ECR, KMS,
STS), which the network stack's VPC endpoint list owns.

## web

| Host | Purpose | Via proxy | Enabled when |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bedrock-runtime.<region>.amazonaws.com` | Bedrock model inference | no | always |
| `secretsmanager.<region>.amazonaws.com` | Container platform: secrets injected at task start | no | always |
| `logs.<region>.amazonaws.com` | Container platform: log delivery | no | always |
| `169.254.170.2` | Container platform: task role credentials (plain HTTP, link-local) | no | always |
| `bedrock-agentcore.<region>.amazonaws.com` | AgentCore: runtime invocation, browser sessions, stored API keys | no | AGENTCORE_RUNTIME_ARN set or AGENTCORE_BROWSER_ENABLED=1 |
| `email.<region>.amazonaws.com` | SES: sign-in links and invitation email | yes | INVITE_EMAIL_PROVIDER=ses |
| `github.com` | GitHub OAuth token exchange (connector and sign-in) | yes | github in ENABLED_CONNECTOR_PROVIDERS or in AUTH_PROVIDERS |
| `api.github.com` | GitHub REST API: sign-in profile, webhook subscriptions | yes | github in ENABLED_CONNECTOR_PROVIDERS or in AUTH_PROVIDERS |
| `api.githubcopilot.com` | GitHub MCP server: the connector's tools | yes | github in ENABLED_CONNECTOR_PROVIDERS and GITHUB_MCP_URL not empty |
| `oauth2.googleapis.com` | Google OAuth token exchange and refresh | yes | google in ENABLED_CONNECTOR_PROVIDERS |
| `gmail.googleapis.com` | Gmail API | yes | google in ENABLED_CONNECTOR_PROVIDERS |
| `www.googleapis.com` | Google Calendar API | yes | google in ENABLED_CONNECTOR_PROVIDERS |
| `api.notion.com` | Notion OAuth token exchange and API | yes | notion in ENABLED_CONNECTOR_PROVIDERS |
| `login.salesforce.com` | Salesforce OAuth token exchange and refresh | yes | salesforce in ENABLED_CONNECTOR_PROVIDERS |
| `*.salesforce.com` | Salesforce API on the user's own instance | yes | salesforce in ENABLED_CONNECTOR_PROVIDERS |
| `*.force.com` | Salesforce API on the user's own instance | yes | salesforce in ENABLED_CONNECTOR_PROVIDERS |
| `api.search.brave.com` | Brave web search | yes | WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER=brave |
| `*` | URL fetch tool: any public web page the user names | yes | WEB_FETCH_ENABLED=1 |
| `us.i.posthog.com` | PostHog product analytics (browser events relay through /ingest) | yes | ANALYTICS_PROVIDER=posthog |
| `us-assets.i.posthog.com` | PostHog product analytics (browser events relay through /ingest) | yes | ANALYTICS_PROVIDER=posthog |
